title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Language Model for Controllable Object Arrangement
abstract: arXiv:2610.28280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning about fine-grained placement constraints, such as support and containment, is essential for realistic 3D scene creation. It remains a significant challenge for existing methods that rely on simplified object representations like oriented bounding box (OBB), which are blind to the detailed geometry. To address this limitation, we introduce GALA, a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception for controllable object placement. Our model performs autoregressively by predicting the 6D pose of one target object at a time conditioned on the scene context and placement instruction. We utilize a two-stage training strategy: the first stage aligns geometric and textual modalities through pretraining tasks, and the second stage fine-tunes the model for placement. translated_title: GALA：面向可控物体排布的几何感知语言模型
translated_abstract: 对细粒度放置约束（如支撑与包容关系）进行推理，对于创建真实的3D场景至关重要。然而，现有方法依赖于有向包围盒（OBB）等简化的物体表示，无法感知详细的几何信息，这仍然是一个重大挑战。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了GALA，一个具有显式点云感知能力的几何感知语言模型，用于实现可控的物体放置。我们的模型以自回归方式工作，在场景上下文和放置指令的条件下，每次预测一个目标物体的6D位姿。我们采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段通过预训练任务对齐几何与文本模态，第二阶段针对放置任务对模型进行微调。为支持该任务，我们还整理了一个多源场景数据集，涵盖多样化的房间类型和细粒度的家具排布。
tldr: 提出了GALA，一个具备显式点云感知能力的几何感知语言模型，通过两阶段训练策略，以自回归方式预测物体6D位姿，从而实现对支撑、包容等细粒度几何约束的可控物体排布。
en_tdlr: GALA is a geometry-aware language model with explicit point cloud perception that autoregressively predicts 6D object poses under fine-grained placement constraints (e.g., support and containment), enabled by a two-stage training strategy and a curated multi-source scene dataset.
